input.title: Men's Mechanic – No, I Can't Just Take a Quick Look Hoodie
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

No, I can't just take a quick look: a mechanic eats his sandwich on his lunch break while three people wait with their car keys, and this mechanic hoodie says what every shop worker is thinking. It is a warm layer for the cold bay in December, and an easy Christmas gift for the mechanic who has heard it all week.

The print is a 1950s shop-poster scene: a mechanic in a blue cap and coveralls sits on an oil drum with a thermos and a big sandwich while a man, a woman and a young man in a ball cap wait behind him, with a blue tool chest and a wrench on the ground. NO, I CAN'T JUST runs across the top in cream capitals and TAKE A QUICK LOOK. sits below in red slab letters.

Wear it to the shop, the cold garage on a weekend or any family dinner where somebody has a car that makes a noise. Printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

What is the No, I Can't Just Take a Quick Look hoodie?
It is a men's pullover hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. showing a 1950s mechanic eating a sandwich on his lunch break while three people wait with their car keys, lettered NO, I CAN'T JUST TAKE A QUICK LOOK. It is a Gildan 18500 in 8 oz cotton-poly fleece with a double-lined hood.

How does the hoodie fit?
This Graphic Tees Co. hoodie is a classic unisex pullover cut in sizes S through 3XL, with a double-lined hood, front pouch pocket and ribbed cuffs. Order your usual size, or go up one for a roomier fit over a work shirt. If the size is off, the first exchange is free.

How do I wash it so the print lasts?
Wash your Quick Look hoodie inside out in cold water and tumble dry low. It is 50% pre-shrunk cotton and 50% polyester at 8 oz, so it holds its shape, and the cream, red and blue inks stay crisp through a winter of shop days and wash cycles.

Is it a good gift for a mechanic?
Yes. It suits the mechanic, tech or shop owner who is tired of hearing it will only take a minute, and it is an easy Christmas gift from a spouse or the crew. It is $39.99 from Graphic Tees Co. in Sand and Navy, with a free size exchange within 30 days.

Can I get it by Christmas?
Order by about December 8 and your Graphic Tees Co. Quick Look hoodie should arrive before Christmas. Each hoodie is printed the day you order it, so ship times vary a little by location. Orders over $45 ship free, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess on size.
